EXERCISE 5 — Error Correction (Formal Academic Style) 
Correct the errors. 
1. Many celebrities enjoys a luxury lifestyle but suffers from stress. 
2. Fame can cause peoples to feel isolating and expose. 
3. The media often publishing private photos without permission. 
4. Maintaining fame require a lot of emotional stability. 
5. Celebrities can using their platform for social causes. 
NEW EXERCISE 6 — Advanced Word-Formation & Sentence Building 
Task A — Word Formation 
Use the words in brackets to form the correct advanced noun or adjective 
related to celebrities. 
1. Constant online attacks can cause severe _________ in famous 
individuals. (harass) 
2. Managing unwanted media attention requires strong _________ 
skills. (resilient) 
3. Many stars struggle with the _________ nature of fame. (transient) 
4. Their work often involves high levels of public _________. (expose) 
5. Some celebrities use their visibility for meaningful social _________. 
(advocate) 
IELTS Essay Topic 
"Many people think that being a celebrity is far more challenging than 
it appears. Do the advantages of celebrity status outweigh the 
disadvantages?"
